items.title: Kuala Langat MP Demands Equal Compensation For Five FDS Victims
items.summary: Kuala Langat MP Ahmad Yunus calls for equal compensation for the families of all five victims of the Long Lellang tragedy, saying it was disappointing that this wasn't announced in Budget 2027. MOH announced RM130,000 payouts to families of its four staff. The post Kuala Langat MP Demands Equal Compensation For Five FDS Victims appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: MCTC Claims Possible Government Attempt To Delist Liquid Nicotine Again
items.summary: MCTC says the government is possibly renewing its attempt to exempt liquid nicotine from the Poisons List by returning to the Poisons Board, after the High Court nullified the 2023 exemption. MCTC urges the Board to again reject any proposed exemption. The post MCTC Claims Possible Government Attempt To Delist Liquid Nicotine Again appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Overcrowding In Emergency Departments, Ward Bed Shortages In Government Hospitals — Assistant Medical Officer
items.summary: Malaysia doesn't need to directly "import" foreign experts to manage the local system. Instead, adapting proven international modules while providing sufficient space, authority, and funding for local public health experts to execute reforms is sufficient. The post Overcrowding In Emergency Departments, Ward Bed Shortages In Government Hospitals — Assistant Medical Officer appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: When Perak’s Trauma Centre Has No C-Arm — Specialist
items.summary: C-arm is essential imaging equipment that allows surgeons to see bones and implants in real time during many fracture fixation procedures. When this equipment became unavailable at HRPB, cases had to be diverted to other hospitals in the state. The post When Perak’s Trauma Centre Has No C-Arm — Specialist appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Sarawak Presents RM500,000 Aid To Five FDS Victims’ Families
items.summary: At a Kuching ceremony, Sarawak Premier Abang Jo presents RM100,000 cheques to each family of 5 victims killed in the Long Lellang tragedy, besides education sponsorships for their kids. One of the widows, Stephanie, says Sarawak helped a lot from Day One. The post Sarawak Presents RM500,000 Aid To Five FDS Victims’ Families appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Revert To Pre-2016 For True ‘Abolition’ Of Contract Doctor System
items.summary: To truly “abolish” the contract doctor system, all medical graduates entering housemanship in 2027 should be automatically made permanent staff on Day One of training — reverting back to pre-2016 — so that 2026 will mark the last contract doctor cohorts. The post Revert To Pre-2016 For True ‘Abolition’ Of Contract Doctor System appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.summary: The partnership establishes a pathway to introduce niche vaccines in Malaysia and provides a foundation for collaboration on future vaccine pipeline opportunities. The post Duopharma Biotech Expands Vaccine Portfolio With Enimmune appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Mandate Mediation For Medical Negligence Complaints Before Lawsuits, Says APHM
items.summary: APHM's Dr Kuljit Singh wants medical negligence disputes to undergo mandatory mediation before suing. He says litigation fears are also driving defensive medicine and higher health care utilisation. Doctors can't use cost-saving for patients as a defence. The post Mandate Mediation For Medical Negligence Complaints Before Lawsuits, Says APHM appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Putrajaya Paying RM130,000 Each To Four FDS Crash Victims’ Families
items.summary: MOH announces federal lump-sum payments of at least RM130,000 to each family of its four staff killed in the Long Lellang tragedy. But MOH didn't mention any payment from Putrajaya for the family of the fifth victim, the pilot, who was a private worker. The post Putrajaya Paying RM130,000 Each To Four FDS Crash Victims’ Families appeared first on CodeBlue .
